notes: I removed the separate power-law branch for |x|<0.3: E15 shows the near-zero outputs are noise-dominated (values scattered around 0 with magnitude ~1-3, not following 16.8·|x|^0.75), so a single linear rule 16.8·|x| is the best mechanism-level guess, with the understanding that small-|x| predictions will be off by the noise floor.
